recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-27740 unless a later PA or vocabulary decision changes the organization-role CodeSystem wording.
issue_request: FHIR-27740 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request for the R4 organization-role CodeSystem because the Provider concept lacked a definition. The accepted R5 wording was: "An organization that delivers care services (e.g. hospitals, clinics, community and social services, etc.)."
initial_application: Commit 43999f77222583823c961400bb79b93af8e853c3, "#FHIR-27740 Update provider code definition", added the accepted Provider definition to source/organizationaffiliation/codesystem-organization-role.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists organizationaffiliation as an active PA-owned resource with FMM 1, so the checked CodeSystem source is in current build scope. PA January 2022 WGM minutes page 81029757 records no objections to the definition, a decision to add examples, and Vote 7/0/0. Direct Zulip search for FHIR-27740 found no discussion, and broader organization-role/provider searches did not reveal a conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source edit was made because source/organizationaffiliation/codesystem-organization-role.xml and the combined branch already contain the accepted Provider definition.
